option.label: Nuclear PPA (firm carbon-free)
option.reasoning: Real deals (Constellation-Microsoft Crane restart Sep 2024; Meta-Constellation Clinton Jun 2025; Talen-Amazon 2025) are undisclosed; analyst estimates ~$80-100+/MWh, restart-premium reports higher. Game uses ~$100-130 baseline with scenario shifts.
sources: Constellation/Microsoft Crane Clean Energy Center announcement, 2024-09-20

effects.queue_skip: No interconnection queue: MW energized at deal signing + 8 weeks of commissioning
effects.tenant_pull: +1 tier of hyperscaler appetite for the site; hyperscaler lease rate +3% (designed)
effects.heat_ratepayer: Ratepayer Anger -5 vs grid gas expansion (firm carbon-free, no new rate-base); Heat unaffected
effects.price_vs_grid: Fixed, indexed 0%; a premium of ~$25-45/MWh over Act II regional grid power in S0/S1/S3; in S2 it becomes cheap vs PJM/ERCOT spikes
effects.cost_of_lock: take-or-pay: pay for 90% of contracted MW regardless of use for 15 years

scenario_behaviour.s0: Flat price; mild advantage in tenant pull; break-even vs grid over 15y.
scenario_behaviour.s1: Take-or-pay becomes a burden for leveraged single-tenant players; still cannot be defaulted on.
scenario_behaviour.s2: Best-in-class: grid prices spike, PPA fixed. Pre-trigger signing is the tell-tale winner move.
scenario_behaviour.s3: Efficiency shock lowers MW demand; oversized PPA volumes strand. Small deals fine.

eligibility.note: Restricted to nuclear-adjacent regions to keep it a decision.
eligibility.reasoning: Designed; ERCOT/Arizona have Comanche Peak/Palo Verde but merchant/utility constraints - flag F-8

events.text: Restarted reactor hits capacity; hyperscalers eye next site.
